Method of Attack: Information stealing of credentials and cookies stored in browsers to hijack social media accounts
Stealing and decrypting browser cookies and credentials using Windows Crypt API and browser-specific functions
Exfiltration of stolen data via HTTP POST requests to C2 server
Disguised installation as Telegram desktop app via software cracks, free software, games, and torrent downloads
Downloading additional modules from C2 servers after initial infection
Impacted Systems: Social media platforms including Facebook, Instagram, Amazon, eBay, Etsy, Twitter, WAX Cloud wallet
Attack Vector: Installation through software cracks, free software, games, and other files downloaded from torrent sites
Disguised as Telegram desktop app to evade detection
